source.source_title: iPod nano (3rd generation) - Technical Specifications - Apple Support (IE)
source.verification_notes: Official Apple technical-specification HTML archived on 2026-11-11. 19 model-specific sections are retained. The first section preserves model-identification evidence from Apple's separate identification page.
notes: Technical values are transcribed from the model-specific technical-specification sections; each field names its source section.
Model-identification evidence remains preserved in the first section from https://support.apple.com/en-ie/103823, archived at apple_remaining_extraction/technical_specs_html/ipod-index.html.

extraction.note: Official Apple iPod identification text retained. Explicit model numbers, introduction dates, capacity options and navigation interface extracted where present with source-section provenance. These are identification-page records, not full historical technical-specification sheets; no absent specs inferred. Model-specific technical-specification sections are preserved with section-level source_url/source_file; this archival pass does not populate or upgrade typed normalized fields.

sections.heading: iPod nano (3rd generation)
sections.source_text:
Navigation: Click Wheel
Capacity: 4 and 8 GB
Model number and date introduced: A1236: September 2007
You can distinguish the iPod nano (3rd generation) from previous iPod nano models by:
Its wider screen
Hold switch is on the bottom
Its ability to play video
The last three characters of the serial number will be one of these: YOP, YOR, YXR, YXT, YXV or YXX.
The iPod nano (3rd generation) comes in five colours.

sections.heading: Size and weight
sections.source_text:
Height: 2.75 inches (69.8 mm)
Width: 2.06 inches (52.3 mm)
Depth: 0.26 inch (6.5 mm)
Weight: 1.74 ounces (49.2 grams)

sections.heading: In the box
sections.source_text:
iPod nano
Earphones
USB 2.0 cable
Dock adapter
Quick Start guide

sections.heading: Capacity
sections.source_text:
4GB or 8GB flash drive
1
Holds up to 1,000 or 2,000 songs in 128-Kbps AAC format
2
Holds up to 3,500 or 7,000 iPod-viewable photos
3
Holds up to 4 hours (4GB) or up to 8 hours (8GB) of video
4
Stores data via USB flash drive

sections.heading: Display
sections.source_text:
2-inch (diagonal) liquid crystal display with blue-white LED backlight
320-by-240-pixel resolution at 204 pixels per inch

sections.heading: Audio
sections.source_text:
Skip-free playback
Frequency response: 20Hz to 20,000Hz
Audio formats supported: AAC (16 to 320 Kbps), Protected AAC (from iTunes Store), MP3 (16 to 320 Kbps), MP3 VBR, Audible (formats 2, 3, and 4), Apple Lossless, AIFF, and WAV
User-configurable maximum volume limit

sections.heading: Video
sections.source_text: H.264 video, up to 1.5 Mbps, 640 by 480 pixels, 30 frames per second, Low-Complexity version of the H.264 Baseline Profile with AAC-LC audio up to 160 Kbps, 48kHz, stereo audio in .m4v, .mp4, and .mov file formats; H.264 video, up to 2.5 Mbps, 640 by 480 pixels, 30 frames per second, Baseline Profile up to Level 3.0 with AAC-LC audio up to 160 Kbps, 48kHz, stereo audio in .m4v, .mp4, and .mov file formats; MPEG-4 video, up to 2.5 Mbps, 640 by 480 pixels, 30 frames per second, Simple Profile with AAC-LC audio up to 160 Kbps, 48kHz, stereo audio in .m4v, .mp4, and .mov file formats

sections.heading: Headphones
sections.source_text:
Earphones
Frequency response: 20Hz to 20,000Hz
Impedance: 32 ohms

sections.heading: Mac system requirements
sections.source_text:
Mac computer with USB 2.0 port
Mac OS X v10.4.8 or later
iTunes 7.4 or later
5

sections.heading: Windows system requirements
sections.source_text:
PC with USB 2.0 port
Windows Vista or Windows XP Home or Professional with Service Pack 2 or later
iTunes 7.4 or later
5

sections.heading: Languages
sections.source_text:
Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Swedish, Traditional Chinese, and Turkish
Additional language support for display of song, album, and artist information: Bulgarian, Croatian, Romanian, Serbian, Slovak, Slovenian, and Ukrainian

sections.heading: Environmental requirements
sections.source_text:
Operating temperature: 32° to 95° F (0° to 35° C)
Nonoperating temperature: -4° to 113° F (-20° to 45° C)
Relative humidity: 5% to 95% noncondensing
Maximum operating altitude: 10,000 feet (3000 m)

sections.heading: Input and output
sections.source_text:
Dock connector
3.5-mm stereo headphone jack

sections.heading: Power and battery 6
sections.source_text:
Built-in rechargeable lithium ion battery
Playback time
Music playback time: Up to 24 hours when fully charged
Video playback time: Up to 5 hours when fully charged
Charging via USB to computer system or power adapter (sold separately)
Fast-charge time: about 1.5 hours (charges up to 80% of battery capacity)
Full-charge time: about 3 hours

sections.heading: Limited warranty and service
sections.source_text: Your iPod comes with single-incident telephone support for the first 90 days and a one-year limited warranty. Purchase the AppleCare Protection Plan for iPod to extend your service and support to two full years. Only theAppleCare Protection Plan provides you with direct telephone support from Apple technical experts and the assurance that repairs will be handled by Apple-certified technicians using genuine Apple parts. For more information, visit Apple support or call 800-823-2775.
